newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Filter to buy United Utilities division.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Filter to buy United Utilities division.

text.p: U.S. Filter Corp said it agreed to buy United Utilities Plc's Process Equipment Division for about $195 million in cash and stock, subject to adjustment.
U.S. Filter believes the transaction will be additive to earnings this fiscal year.

The division manufactures water and wastewater treatment equipment under brands such as Wallace and Tiernan, Envirex and General Filter. This sale follows United Utilities' announcement in March of its intention to divest its process equipment business.

For the fiscal year ended March 31, 1996 the division had revenues of about $270 million with about 64 percent generated in North America, 25 percent in Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and 11 percent in the Pacific Rim.
The transaction is expected to be completed in the fourth quarter. The sale is subject to the approval under the U.S.

Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976. The company also indicated it expects to finance certain pending acquisitions with a combination of new equity and convertible debt to be issued later this fall.
